name: Feta Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: feta cheese, crumbled into about 1/2-inch pieces

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 400°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.

Place chicken breasts, skin side up, on a prepared sheet. Brush all over with oil and season with 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt and 3/4 teaspoon pepper. Roast until the thickest part of the breast registers 155°F in the center, 40 to 55 minutes. Cool to room temperature, about 40 minutes.
Remove meat from bones and discard skin and bones. Cut chicken into 1/2-inch cubes (about 4 cups).
In a large bowl, combine mayo, yogurt, parsley, dill, lemon zest and juice, remaining 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.
Add chicken, scallions, and feta and gently fold until combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with lettuce, in a wrap, or as a sandwich.

schema_metadata.keywords: chicken salad recipe, Feta Chicken Salad

description: Upgrade basic chicken salad with feta, fresh herbs, and a tangy yogurt-mayo dressing that's perfect for sandwiches, wraps, and lettuce cups.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 45 min.

Notes: About 4 cups of chopped rotisserie chicken can be used in place of cooking your own chicken, if desired. If using rotisserie chicken, start the recipe at step 5.
For variations, try adding 1/2 cup of chopped pepperoncini, cherry peppers, celery, or fresh cucumber.

Make-ahead and storage: The chicken salad can be eaten right away or covered and refrigerated for up to 3 days to let the flavors meld.
author: Amanda Luchtel
